title: Maritime archaeology event to take place at Dorchester venue this month
description: The Dorchester Association for Research into Local History and Archaeology will hold a Maritime Archaeology event on October 31 at Dorford Centre, Dorchester.

title: The fossil fuel playbook: How coal and gas bought time, and how to take it back
description: The fossil fuels playbook works best in the dark, but there are signs the lights are coming on, writes Dr Robyn Gulliver. The post The fossil fuel playbook: How coal and gas bought time, and how to take it back appeared first on The Klaxon.

title: ArcheAge WAR Revamps Ancient Forest, Adds Baadran
How dolerite turned the Karoo into an ancient canvas and a barrier to fracking
description: The dolerite that underpins the geo-history and water wealth of the Karoo became the ancient canvas for our First Artists. It has also dashed the dreams of would-be shale gas frackers.

title: UNESCO Tentative List: Why Chhattisgarh’s Ancient Sirpur Deserves A Place On Your Travel Bucket List
description: Located on the banks of the Mahanadi River, Sirpur is an archaeological treasure trove where Hindu, Buddhist and Jain heritage come together.
